## The heuristic

**Self-service only works on questions that have one right answer. Anything account-specific, ambiguous or emotionally loaded should be routed to a human deliberately, and the right deflection rate for those intents is none.**


_Why:_ A failed deflection does not cost one ticket. It costs the wasted attempt, the ticket that follows, and the customer's new belief that we hide behind our documentation — and that last cost never appears on the support ledger.
